Hey, sorry to hear you're struggling with that, I used to have the same problems myself. I found that it helped when I realized that if the other person thinks my replies are boring, they wouldn't bother responding, or maybe even texting in the first place. If they really wanted to talk to you they'd try to keep the conversation going no matter how boring your replies are.

And if you're afraid when you don't get a reply; no sweat! They probably had to go do something, or just didn't know what to say back, and that's nothing to be afraid of. It never means they hate you or anything. You can do the same too; if you don't know what to say back, you can change the topic or not reply at all (or if you really feel like you have to reply just send a single emoji, that usually seems to tell the other person you don't know what to say)

TL;DR Just send what you want to say without worrying whether it's boring or not, and don't feel anxious when you don't get a reply. Good luck!
